remarks: Looking for a home that combines modern comfort with a great community?     Welcome to Brookside Country Club, a beautiful gated community where residents of all ages can enjoy a comfortable and welcoming lifestyle. Built in 2021, this charming 3-bedroom, 2-bathroom home features modern finishes and a welcoming feel. The kitchen comes with elegant quartz countertops, a stove, refrigerator, dishwasher, and microwave. Plus, enjoy the comfort of air conditioning year-round!  One of the best parts?
